source_text.body:
Hand browser work like rostering and lead scraping to Grok Bot
A user delegates browser tasks to Grok Bot's cloud computer, including operating rostering software, scraping leads and research where API or OAuth isn't possible.
·
Oct 24, 2025
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
One commenter said they hand Grok Bot any browser-heavy work, including operating rostering software, scraping leads, and doing research. The key setup they described is using Grok Bot’s cloud computer for sites and workflows where APIs or OAuth are unavailable, while they keep Claude and local Python scripts for work on their own machine.
How it went
They said Grok Bot made initial setup much easier and worked far better for Chrome and browser automation than Claude. The limitation they gave was that Claude remained their daily driver for local tasks and script-based workflows.
Worth knowing
The main catch was choosing tools by environment: Grok Bot for cloud-browser tasks without API access, Claude for local work and existing Python-based projects.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Use your cloud computer's browser to do this job on a site with no API: [e.g. log into [rostering software] and update next week's roster / scrape leads from [site] matching [criteria]]. Collect the results into a spreadsheet or summary at [format or location] and tell me when it is complete. Pause and show me before submitting any form, publishing a roster, or sending anything to other people.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xbzn1s/claude_users_how_are_you_using_grokbot_where_do
